findings.title: minimatch development dependency advisory
findings.details: R19 freshly checks current consumer releases and upstream manifests. TypeDoc 0.28.20 still needs ^10.2.5; ESLint 9/10, eslintrc/config-array and latest typescript-estree still need old minimatch. No compatible published fix in the reviewed chain. Need a maintained compatible consumer supporting fixed >=11.0.1 or official backport, then real lint/docs and full audits. No shim, private fork, tool removal, forced major or waiver applied. Raw audits remain red: 14 web + 2 SDK affected dev nodes.
findings.closure: A maintained consumer release/backport compatible with minimatch >=11.0.1, validated with real lint/docs and full audits, or a separately justified policy decision. The observed preprocessing coverage and production boundary guard do not close the advisory.

findings.title: First-time creator needed allowance; the existing fee digest binding was misdescribed
findings.details: Correction to R14: managed_template_digest already binds fee token, exact amount and treasury. Routed creation now charges by atomic direct transfer under the manager creation authorization, with zero allowance. The client preserves the reviewed digest and exact fee when preparing against a refreshed profile. Existing non-routed creation remains allowance based.
findings.fix: Keep existing create_managed_routes ABI, a single wallet confirmation, no fee-approval transaction, no automatic deposit, no extra planner or financial retry. Missing creator configuration does not block withdrawal profiles.
findings.limit: Host-enforced source-account auth and native MockAuth are separate from the 58 real ephemeral Ed25519 cases. Real Freighter fee authorization and consensus remain unqualified.

findings.title: One RustSec vulnerability remains in both SDK host/test lock scopes
findings.details: R19 freshly reviews SDK 23.5.3, hosts 23.0.2/29.0.2/30.0.0 and current host master. They retain old RustCrypto chains; fixed crypto-bigint >=0.7.6 cannot satisfy current ^0.5. Need a supported upstream host/SDK migration and requalification, or a separately authorized independent native-tooling risk decision. Raw workspace, quote-adapter and R18 P29 host audits remain red; guest normal/build graphs exclude the affected crate. No Rust lock/guest/WASM change or local crypto patch.
findings.closure: A compatible upstream host/RustCrypto integration and requalification, or an explicit independently reviewed risk decision for native tooling exposure. Manual public-verification input review and absence from guest graphs do not repair the vulnerable library or qualify the production validator host.

findings.title: Creation preparation could renew reviewed template and fee terms
findings.fix: Include templateHash and exact creationFee in the checked draft. Backend, client ABI verifier and UI compare them before signing; contract digest rejects changed token, amount or treasury. Balance is checked without allowance.

findings.title: Active creation action was inside contextual help and could coexist with legacy creation
findings.fix: Render the approved creator as the primary review flow, invalidate checked drafts synchronously when context changes, and disable/remove legacy creation when the new creator flag is selected. Preview stays contextual; receipt recovery stays visible when execution is disabled.

findings.title: CI stopped collecting npm evidence after the first failing workspace
findings.fix: Collect all three full audit JSON reports even after a failure, then return a failing status. Keep both raw RustSec audits and the mainnet gate unchanged. Add Node production and wasm guest exposure guards as supplements, not audit replacements.
findings.limit: Actual Bash collector behavior was tested with a fake npm executable. Hosted CI has not run or been published.

Aggregate managed USD estimates use the existing available-cash helper so fixed claims are not counted as managed assets.

findings.title: Compiled local proxy configuration rejected legitimate loopback reads
findings.details: The local build preset omitted the managed read-only flag required by the proxy. Next 15.5.28 also normalizes 127.0.0.1 to localhost in NextRequest.url, causing the exact URL/Host guard to reject valid requests.
findings.fix: Set both required read-only build flags and use the existing Next skipMiddlewareUrlNormalize configuration to preserve the original URL. Keep proxy Host/Origin/backend validation unchanged. Exercise native NextRequest, valid HTTPS/loopback and rejected changed hosts/origins.
findings.limit: Local candidate configuration defect; production impact is not established. No new API exception, financial heuristic, dependency or contract change.

findings.title: El refresco remonta y cierra el historial paginado
findings.trigger: Historial abierto en offset25; llega la siguiente observación en el poll de10segundos
findings.observed: La key contiene observationId; se desmontan details y estado de página. La consulta vuelve a quedar cerrada y pierde su posición.
findings.impact: Interrumpe la navegación por historial. No modifica derechos, reservas ni contratos.
findings.closure: Conservar la sesión de lectura fijada mientras se navega, con reinicio seguro al cambiar fund/owner/code; comprobar polling, lectura tardía y actualización explícita sin mezclar páginas de observaciones distintas.
findings.fix: Open session pinned to immutable history metadata; refresh on close/reopen, boundary reset on fund/owner/code and late-read rejection.

findings.introducedBy: R37 active-only response interacting with the prior watched-request notice
findings.title: Una solicitud cerrada puede conservar el aviso de pendiente
findings.trigger: La solicitud observada se paga/cierra y deja de aparecer en requestsScope=active
findings.observed: withdrawalProgressNotice devuelve null y currentNotice reutiliza el aviso previo de solicitud/pendiente, mientras el agregado histórico ya registra el cobro.
findings.impact: Estado de interfaz engañoso después de un pago o cierre. No se reproduce otra transferencia ni pérdida de fondos.
findings.closure: Al desaparecer del índice activo completo, retirar el aviso de pendiente o resolver esa solicitud con historia verificada. No inferir pago/cancelación de una ausencia o de un agregado; validar pago, cancelación, residuo, auto-payout y cambio de propietario.
findings.fix: Neutral absent-request notice only with complete nontruncated active view; no paid/cancelled inference or extra lookup.

findings.title: Una lectura superada puede reemplazar el estado o error de una lectura más reciente
findings.trigger: Mismo fondo/owner; dos lecturas periódicas o manuales solapadas terminan fuera de orden.
observed: Posición reconciliada del ledger102 reemplazada por el ledger101 al completar tarde la lectura anterior.
Un error anterior vuelve a marcar unavailable y deshabilita acciones después de una respuesta nueva correcta.
La cartera vuelve al resultado anterior vacío y oculta la posición nueva verificada.
findings.cause: El fondo comprueba sólo id/wallet/owner; la cartera sólo si el controller de la sesión está abortado. Ninguna de las dos selecciona la lectura vigente entre solicitudes del mismo contexto.
findings.impact: Retroceso de importes/derechos presentados y disponibilidad de controles de interfaz. No hay pérdida, doble cobro ni autorización financiera saltada demostrados.
findings.closure: Corrected and validated locally in R41; see docs/READ_COHERENCE_R41.md. No production incident or financial loss established.
findings.fix: Per-view request identity accepts only latest started read success/error within the current session; cleanup invalidates fund reads and aborts portfolio sessions.

findings.title: Initial passive reset can erase deposit input after mount without a confirmation reset
findings.observed: El botón Review authorization queda deshabilitado y el DOM de fallo muestra el importe vacío. La suite completa falla ese caso; ocho ejecuciones aisladas pasan.
findings.closure: Corrected and validated locally in R41; see docs/READ_COHERENCE_R41.md. No production incident or financial loss established.
findings.fix: Initial state remains empty without a mount reset. Apply amount/error/quote clearing before commit only when the confirmed-deposit reset changes; preserve selected asset/tolerance.

findings.title: El error de refresco posterior a una confirmación persiste tras una lectura recuperada
findings.trigger: La operación simulada termina correctamente; la lectura vigente posterior falla; el siguiente polling obtiene datos correctos.
findings.cause: load guarda loadError y lanza el error actual. El catch de confirm lo duplica en error de operación. Un éxito posterior limpia loadError/ledgerUnavailable, pero no error.
findings.impact: Alerta obsoleta en la vista recuperada. Se muestran datos actuales y los controles vuelven a estar disponibles. No se demuestra fallo de contrato, pérdida o salto de autorización.
findings.closure: Corrected in R43, with targeted/full/frontend/build/browser receipts required for final closure.
findings.fix: Post-confirmation load rejection is handled by the existing loadError/ledgerUnavailable state; it cannot become an operation error. Current read failure blocks until recovery; genuine operation errors persist.

findings.title: Un fallo tardío al consultar el recibo de otro owner se muestra en la vista nueva
findings.trigger: Consulta de confirmación del owner A pendiente; la vista cambia al owner B; la consulta anterior rechaza.
findings.cause: El resultado correcto de receipt comprueba id/wallet/owner, pero su catch publica el error sin comprobar contexto.
findings.impact: Mensaje de error de A en la vista de B. El recibo de A se conserva, el de B no se modifica y no se ejecuta ninguna operación financiera.
findings.closure: Corrected in R43, with targeted/full/frontend/build/browser receipts required for final closure.
findings.fix: Existing context object is stable per fund/wallet/owner session; receipt success/error require the selected object and owner=wallet, including A→B→A. Matching receipt and no-resend guards preserved.

findings.title: Una comprobación de transacción de la vista anterior publica su resultado o error tras cambiar de cuenta o fondo
findings.trigger: Con ejecución deshabilitada, iniciar Check transaction y cambiar de cuenta o fondo antes de completarse la preparación.
findings.cause: La rama de confirm para Check transaction publica setNotice/setError tras await checkGeneralAction sin comprobar que siga vigente la sesión seleccionada.
findings.impact: Mensaje de comisión de A en la vista B o rechazo Wallet changed de A en B. Es una consulta; no se invoca el ejecutor, se firma, reenvía o altera un recibo. No se demuestra pérdida ni bypass financiero.
findings.realAdapterProof: El adaptador y validador reales aceptan un envelope sin firmas dirigido al fondo A; tras cambiar a B, aparece su comisión de0.7654321 XLM en B. Si cambia la cuenta, el adaptador rechaza correctamente Wallet changed, pero el catch publica ese rechazo anterior en la vista nueva. Sólo respuestas HTTP y lectores de clave pública son dobles.
findings.closure: R45 binds both Check transaction outcomes to the existing session identity. Twenty actual unsigned-adapter regression cases, complete frontend and local release/build/browser receipts qualify the new candidate.
findings.fix: Capture context.current once; publish success/error only while it remains that same object. Preserve current errors, same-session polling, existing entry guards and unconditional busy release.

findings.title: Una cotización del gestor cuyo componente se desmontó abre una revisión en el contexto nuevo
findings.trigger: Iniciar Review asset change en A, cambiar de cuenta o fondo mientras el GET quote está pendiente y recibir después la cotización original válida; también A→B→A.
findings.cause: ManagerPortfolioSwap compara su ref local con la selección tras el await, pero no invalida la llamada al desmontarse. El ref de la instancia antigua conserva A y onReview sigue siendo el setter del padre que continúa montado.
findings.impact: Se abre Review before signing con ASSET_A/importe/mínimo de la instancia anterior. En el cambio de cuenta puede reaparecer una propuesta del gestor anterior cuando sus herramientas ya no están visibles. No se invoca automáticamente Check transaction, el ejecutor o una firma; no se demuestra transferencia, pérdida o salto de autorización.
findings.proofBoundary: Componente y adaptador generalPortfolioQuote reales con HTTP y modelos de fondos/direcciones sintéticos. Cambio de wallet por wallet:pubkey-changed dentro del mismo padre; cambio de fondo mediante useParams/rerender. No es una comprobación del router Next en producción ni una ejecución financiera posterior.
findings.closure: R47 adds the existing mounted/selection pattern before publishing a manager quote or error; mounted cleanup cannot open a review in the new parent session.22 actual-adapter cases, full frontend and release/build/browser receipts validate the fix.
findings.fix: One mounted ref and effect cleanup; success/error require mounted plus the unchanged existing selection. Loading cleanup only updates the current mounted component. No new business state, retry, planner or protocol.
